name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet
prompt: A historically grounded late-16th-century Ottoman Janissary infantryman, rendered as crisp 32x32 pixel art across eight compass-direction rotations, isolated on a transparent background, no environment. Stocky, disciplined build; olive skin; thick black mustache with clean-shaven chin per Janissary custom; white felt börk folded over the neck with a small brass kaşıklık holder and short plume. Wears a red wool kaftan trimmed in dark braid, a leather sash at the waist, loose şalvar trousers gathered above simple leather boots. Carries a curved yatağan tucked through the sash and a long matchlock musket with a wooden stock and iron barrel slung across the back, plus a small leather powder pouch at the hip. Clean, saturated period-appropriate color palette (whites, deep reds, browns, iron greys), bold black outlines, readable silhouette at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
